description: This file defines the Chromium class extending BrowserType, implementing methods for launching, connecting, and managing Chromium browser instances within the Playwright project. It includes logic for handling CDP connections, Selenium hub integration, and startup log parsing.

classes.name: Chromium
classes.description: Represents the Chromium browser type with methods for launching, connecting, and managing Chromium instances, including CDP and Selenium integration.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a Chromium browser instance with specified options.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with user data directory.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a Chromium instance over a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint.

methods.name: _connectOverCDPImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation for establishing a CDP connection with cleanup logic.

methods.name: connectOverCDPTransport
methods.description: Connects to a Chromium instance over an existing transport.

methods.name: _createDevTools
methods.description: Creates a CRDevTools instance if the executable is found.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a CRBrowser connection over a transport.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to provide clearer error messages.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for Chromium process.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to gracefully close the browser.

methods.name: _launchWithSeleniumHub
methods.description: Launches Chromium via a Selenium hub, handling capabilities and session management.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Chromium.

methods.name: _innerDefaultArgs
methods.description: Constructs the argument list based on options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready and retrieves the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Determines the executable name based on options.
